Agent Name: WebSurfer
Step Number: 6
Reason for Mistake: The WebSurfer failed to correctly retrieve and analyze the required information from the Wikipedia page. Despite multiple scrolling attempts, the agent stopped prematurely after seeing only the first few entries of the "Studio albums" list (ending in 1970). It incorrectly concluded that there were no albums between 2000 and 2009 because it did not scroll far enough to see the later entries in the table (which include albums like *Cantora* in 2009). This is a failure of data retrieval and validation, where the agent assumed the visible data was complete without verifying the full extent of the list.
